name: chapter-quest
description: Upload a chapter, get a playable 2D RPG that teaches the concept.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm -w @chapter-quest/shared run dev" "npm -w @chapter-quest/server run dev" "npm -w @chapter-quest/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm -w @chapter-quest/server run build && npm -w @chapter-quest/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm -w @chapter-quest/shared run typecheck && npm -w @chapter-quest/server run typecheck && npm -w @chapter-quest/web run typecheck
